subject: Best way to work with PHP - MySQL - RApache

messages.author: eb74a56574cc743b
messages.subject: Best way to work with PHP - MySQL - RApache
parts:
Hello again,

I'm a little bit confused about many ways RApache can work.

My objective is:

1. In a PHP page the user call an analysis;
2. PHP page give to R some data located in a MySQL database
3. R give to a PHP page the results, both graphical and textual, and
the page shows them.

Reading in this forum and in the official documentation I can see some
different point of view:

- there is the brew option that allow to create as many pages as I
want with simple HTML (not PHP) that call R code throught brew code (<
% R code %>)

- there is a .R file that can show results, but in a more difficult
way than brew (trhought cat() etc. and calling it with a r-handler, so
only one page could be called)

- I can pass data from PHP page to brew page with GET or POST reading
it from databases in the PHP page;

- I can do the same thing but reading data with RMySQL library
directly into the R code, but passing the query with GET/POST;

- I must visualize results with CURL function of PHP.

After all these consideration, what is the best way to do what I asked
in the 3 points?

Can I see some code examples?
